name: Thumbnail Compliance Rules
description: Machine-readable compliance rules for evaluating thumbnails against design guidelines.

rules.title: Safe Zone Compliance
rules.question: Are all critical visual elements positioned safely within the image boundaries?
evaluation_instructions: Detect the primary subject.
Detect faces.
Detect the main title.
Detect brand logos.
Detect sponsor logos if present.
For every detected element, classify its prominence as 'primary' (clear, high-contrast, intended as a focal point) or 'background' (faded, low-opacity, gradient-obscured, or decorative texture).
Return bounding boxes for every detected element regardless of prominence -- do not discard background elements.
The backend will calculate a 7% safe margin from each image edge and check every bounding box against it, weighting severity by prominence.

output_schema.reason: Explain whether important elements are safely positioned, and note separately if any low-prominence elements cross the margin.
output_schema.recommendation: Move critical elements further from image edges if necessary.

rules.title: Primary Subject Prominence
rules.question: Does the thumbnail contain one clear primary subject that immediately attracts attention?
evaluation_instructions: Identify the dominant subject.
Estimate visual saliency.
Determine whether viewer attention naturally focuses on one primary subject.

output_schema.reason: Explain whether a clear focal subject exists.
output_schema.recommendation: Reduce competing elements or increase emphasis on the primary subject.

rules.title: Visual Hierarchy
rules.question: Does the composition establish a clear visual hierarchy?
evaluation_instructions: Compare the prominence of the subject, title and branding.
Estimate the order in which viewers notice these elements.
Determine whether the visual flow is logical and intuitive.

output_schema.reason: Explain whether the thumbnail has a clear visual hierarchy.
output_schema.recommendation: Reorganize the layout to improve visual flow.

rules.title: Visual Simplicity
rules.question: Does the thumbnail avoid unnecessary visual clutter?
evaluation_instructions: Estimate scene complexity.
Count visually competing foreground elements.
Determine whether unnecessary objects distract from the main message.

output_schema.reason: Explain whether the artwork appears cluttered.
output_schema.recommendation: Remove unnecessary visual elements to simplify the composition.

rules.title: Title Readability
rules.question: Is the title clearly readable in the thumbnail?
evaluation_instructions: Locate the primary title using OCR.
Estimate OCR confidence.
Measure text contrast against the background.
Check whether the title overlaps important objects.
Determine whether the title remains readable at thumbnail size.

output_schema.reason: Explain whether the title is readable.
output_schema.recommendation: Increase text contrast, size or reposition the title if necessary.

rules.title: Brand Visibility
rules.question: Are branding elements clearly visible and readable?
evaluation_instructions: Detect logos and branding elements.
Estimate their visibility.
Measure contrast.
Determine whether branding overlaps other objects.

output_schema.reason: Explain whether branding is visible and readable.
output_schema.recommendation: Increase branding visibility or reposition branding if necessary.

rules.title: Text Clutter
rules.question: Is the amount of text limited to only essential information?
evaluation_instructions: Extract all visible text using OCR.
Count distinct text regions.
Estimate text density.
Determine whether excessive labels compete with the main title.

output_schema.reason: Explain whether excessive text is present.
output_schema.recommendation: Remove unnecessary labels or secondary text.

rules.title: Title Placement
rules.question: Is the title placed in a clear and unobstructed position?
evaluation_instructions: Locate the title.
Determine whether it overlaps faces or the primary subject.
Determine whether it is positioned close to image edges.
Estimate whether the placement supports readability.

output_schema.reason: Explain whether the title placement is appropriate.
output_schema.recommendation: Move the title to an unobstructed location if required.

rules.title: Asset Specifications
rules.question: Does the uploaded asset match the required dimensions for its asset type?
evaluation_instructions: Read the uploaded image dimensions.
Determine the selected asset type.
Compare the image width and height against the specification table.
Verify aspect ratio.

output_schema.reason: Explain whether the uploaded image matches the required specification.
output_schema.recommendation: Resize or recreate the image using the correct dimensions.
